title: Advancements
blurb: Every advancement in the game, laid out as the five in-game tabs and the order they unlock in. Each one links to its own page with the requirement, the flavour text, and the experience reward.
note: Tier A membership: the kind rule selects all 126 advancement entities, which is every file under advancement/ in the 26.2 data pack minus the recipes/ subtree pipeline/extract/advancement.py excludes on purpose. The tree comes from the parent and children refs the wiki join already resolved onto AdvancementInfo. groupOrder is Tier C: the five tabs render in the order the game's own advancement screen shows them, which no data source publishes. Siblings sort by display name because the game's sibling order is a screen position, not data. Icon borrowed from the Grass Block on story/root, the first advancement anyone earns. Guarded by tests/test_collections_drift.py.
